# Booked — Blog

> Notes on digital presence, AI discoverability, and positioning for fashion creatives.

This is the blog for Booked, a digital infrastructure service for fashion creatives
founded by Luca Bold — a current international fashion model with a decade of
professional experience across Cape Town, Hong Kong, Seoul, Shanghai, Milan, and Bali.

## What this blog covers

Practical, specific writing on why fashion creatives stay invisible online — and
what the infrastructure fix actually looks like. Topics include AI discoverability,
portfolio structure, casting director behaviour, agency roster management, and the
gap between how creatives see themselves and how the industry finds them.

## Posts

- post-01: The creatives who get found consistently have something in common.
- post-02: Why fashion creatives stay invisible online — and it's not your follower count.
- post-03: Your portfolio is costing you bookings. Here's what a good one actually does.
- post-04: The industry sees you differently than you think. That gap is where bookings are lost.
- post-05: I spent a decade being booked. Now I build what needs to exist so the right people find you.
- post-06: What boutique modelling agencies get wrong about their talent's digital presence.
- post-07: Does your name come up when AI recommends creative talent?
- post-08: How casting directors find talent in 2026 — and what most creatives don't know about it.
- post-09: The five things a casting director checks before they call you.
- post-10: Why your Instagram following means nothing without this.
- post-11: What a new signee needs before their first booking.
- post-12: The real reason creatives get passed over for work they were right for.

## Who this is for

Fashion photographers, stylists, creative directors, art directors, hair and makeup
artists, and boutique modelling or creative agency owners managing 5-20 talents.

## The service behind the blog

Booked offers AI discoverability audits (Scan), portfolio website builds (Structure),
bio rewrites, landing pages, and a Roster Infrastructure Retainer for agencies.
